name: hermes
description: Hermes — a self-hosted training platform: plan workouts, sync with Garmin, analyse, and let AI agents coach you over MCP. Runs on Cloudflare Workers + D1.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs session cookies. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`. Changing it later signs everyone out.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts your stored Garmin credentials. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32` and **keep it**: changing it means reconnecting Garmin.

DB.description: D1 database for all your training data. Created for you; migrations run on every deploy.
